## Summary

Explain the change, its motivation, and any context newcomers need.

## Type
- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] docs
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] test
- [ ] chore
- [ ] perf
- [ ] security

## Architecture / Design
Briefly describe affected services, data structures, or proof chain segments.

## Changes
- List key modifications (files, algorithms, APIs)

## Tests
- Added: (unit / integration / e2e)
- Coverage result: paste summary (Go/Rust/Python)

## Metrics & Logging
- New Prometheus metrics? Describe names & cardinality impact.
- Logging changes (new contexts / structured fields).

## Security Considerations
- Input validation changes?
- Cryptographic operations touched?
- Potential attack surface adjustments?

## Performance
- Expected impact (latency, memory, throughput)
- Benchmarks (if available)

## Breaking Changes
- Describe migration steps or compatibility notes.

## Checklist
- [ ] Follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Docs updated (architecture / README / port mappings)
- [ ] No unbounded memory growth
- [ ] Race conditions tested (`go test -race` / equivalent)
- [ ] Ports checked (`PORT_MAPPINGS.md`)
- [ ] Security review completed
- [ ] Patent Pledge compatible (no third‑party encumbrances)

## Related Issues
Closes # (list) / Relates to #

## Screenshots / Diagrams (Optional)
Add any sequence or flow diagrams if helpful.
